title: Liquid Verisium Reference
summary: Liquid Verisium starts a Runic Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription. This guide explains why it is not in the shop, how Feeling Lucky? gates it, and what to check before the encounter begins.
description: A source-linked reference for Liquid Verisium purchase conditions, use behaviour, encounter result, and current restrictions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Liquid Verisium currency item icon - a vial of glowing blue liquid metal from Expedition

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Liquid Verisium is not a normal shop item: it appears only after you allocate Feeling Lucky? on the Expedition Atlas and buy it from Farrow with Verisium.
calloutDetail: Using it immediately starts a Runic Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription.
Be ready to fight the moment you use it; do not use it in town expecting a calm menu.

answers.label: Use it
text: Use it when you want the encounter and your build is ready for immediate combat.

answers.label: Sell it
text: Sell it if you do not need the encounter and the market value exceeds the expected reward.

answers.label: Hold it
text: Hold it until your Atlas and inventory are prepared for the fight.

sections.title: What it does
paragraphs: Per the official 0.5.4 Patch Notes, Liquid Verisium is an Expedition currency. Using it immediately starts a Runic Remnant Encounter that carries a random Runic Inscription.
The random inscription means the exact encounter layout and rewards are not fixed; treat each use as a distinct roll.
bullets: Starts the encounter on use, no separate activation step.
Random Runic Inscription affects the encounter, not a static tooltip.

entries.question: Why is Liquid Verisium not in Farrow's shop?
summary: Players expected a normal shop entry and could not find it.
editorialAnalysis: The shop entry is gated by Feeling Lucky?; without it the item does not appear.
officialAnswer: Allocate Feeling Lucky? on the Expedition Atlas, then check Farrow.

entries.question: Why did a fight start the moment I used it?
summary: A player used it in town and was surprised by the immediate encounter.
editorialAnalysis: This is intended behaviour, not a bug.
officialAnswer: Use it only when ready for immediate combat.

directAnswer: Confirm the use actually consumed the item and that you were in a valid location.
